address_help: Learners and teachers can type this address if their device does not find the Hub.
address_none: Connect this PC to the classroom router to get a Hub address.
error_body: Another program may be using port 8080 or 8081. Close it, then open L.A.R.A Hub again.
admin_setup_help: Set up the school admin on this Hub PC. This account manages accounts and PIN resets.
admin_sign_out_help: You’ll need the admin PIN to sign in again. The Hub will keep running for teachers and learners.
admin_pin_help: Use six digits, including any leading zeros.
admin_existing_action: Admin already set up? Sign in
admin_exists: The admin is already set up. Enter the admin PIN to sign in.
admin_accounts_help: Create teacher or learner accounts and reset forgotten PINs.
admin_empty_body: Create an account or refresh the list when the Hub is available.
admin_pin_once: Give this PIN privately to the account owner. It is shown once and cannot be retrieved after closing.
admin_offline_body: Showing the last loaded accounts. Changes need the Hub. Your form stays open. If a save was interrupted, refresh accounts before trying again.
admin_offline_auth: The Hub is not responding. Keep this window open and try again when the Hub is running.
admin_session_expired: Your admin session ended. Sign in again.
admin_wrong_pin: The admin PIN was not accepted. Check it and try again.
admin_duplicate: That ID or LRN already has an account. Refresh accounts before trying again.
admin_rate_limit: Too many PIN attempts. Wait a minute before trying again.
admin_not_found: That account was not found. Refresh accounts and try again.
admin_forbidden: Only the Hub admin on the Hub PC can use this console.
admin_invalid: Check the account details and enter a 6-digit PIN.
admin_error: The Hub could not confirm this change. Refresh accounts before trying again.
console_overview_help: Check the Hub connection and manage this school’s accounts.
activity_invalid_dates: The end date must be on or after the start date.
activity_incomplete: Some entries are missing or have expired.
activity_empty_help: Requests and Hub events appear here.
log_pin_reset_failed: Account PIN could not be reset
log_gap: Some activity entries were not recorded
log_reason_port: A required port is already in use.
log_reason_network: The classroom network or discovery service is unavailable.
log_reason_document: The document could not be read.
log_reason_no_text: No readable lesson text was extracted.
log_reason_input: The supplied details were not accepted.
log_reason_conflict: The operation conflicts with existing data.
log_reason_write: Activity storage could not be written.
log_reason_exit: The previous Hub session did not finish cleanly.
log_reason_internal: The service could not complete this operation.
import_help: Choose a CSV or Excel (.xlsx) file with LRN and Full name columns. Use the Learners worksheet for Excel. Import up to 500 learners per file (5 MB maximum). Existing accounts are skipped. Learners join classes separately.
import_pin_help: Each new learner gets a generated 6-digit PIN. Keep this window open and download the credentials before closing. PINs are kept only for this session. If credentials are lost, use Reset PIN on the Accounts screen.
import_error_file: Choose a readable CSV or Excel (.xlsx) file no larger than 5 MB.
import_error_headers: Use exactly two columns: LRN and Full name, in that order, with headers in the first row.
import_error_sheet: The Excel file needs a worksheet named Learners.
import_error_limit: Use no more than 500 learner rows. Split larger rosters into separate files.
import_error_empty: The file contains no learners. Add rows below the headers.
import_error_lrn: LRN must contain exactly 12 digits. Store it as text to keep leading zeros.
import_error_name: Full name must contain 1–100 characters after trimming spaces.
import_error_formula: Use plain values rather than formulas in LRN and Full name cells.
import_error_duplicate: This LRN appears more than once in the file. Keep only one row.
import_uncertain: Not confirmed: may need PIN reset
import_counts: Ready: {pending} · Skipped: {skipped} · Invalid: {invalid} · Created: {created} · Needs attention: {uncertain}
import_complete: Import checked. Review the results and download credentials for the accounts created successfully.
import_interrupted: The Hub could not finish this import. Confirmed results are kept here. Keep this window open, then select Check and continue when the Hub is available.
import_uncertain_help: An interrupted request may have created an account. Check and continue refreshes the account list first. Accounts that exist without a confirmed result need Reset PIN; their unconfirmed PINs are excluded from the credential file.
import_save_failed: The file could not be saved. Keep this window open and try again.
import_saved: File saved. When opening credential CSV files in Excel, import LRN and PIN columns as text to preserve leading zeros. Give each learner only their own credentials.
import_template_saved: Template saved. Add the learner details, then choose the completed file here.
import_discard_help: Closing clears the generated PINs from this window. Download the credential file first. Lost PINs must be reset.
activity_no_matches_help: Try another search or clear the filters.
monitor_layout_hint: Arrange the overview to suit your work. Positions are saved on this computer.
monitor_layout_help: Drag a card by its handle and drop it on another card. Cards snap into the grid.
monitor_layout_keyboard: Use arrow keys to move a card earlier or later. Home moves it first, End moves it last. Escape finishes arranging. The arrow buttons also move cards.
monitor_layout_session: Positions could not be saved and will last for this session only.
monitor_connected_help: Live classroom connections. One device may have more than one.
monitor_response_help: Average time until the Hub starts its reply, over the last minute.
monitor_paused_help: Live readings are paused. Values show the last collected sample. Warnings cannot be checked while paused.
monitor_live_scope: Cards show the latest reading; history controls apply to graphs, the table and export.
monitor_group_note: {statistic} of available readings in each {seconds}-second group. Empty groups remain gaps.
monitor_warning_help: Warnings check this computer over a continuous 30-second window. Missing readings are never treated as healthy.
monitor_limit_help: Choose limits for this computer. These warnings do not stop services or send notifications. Defaults: CPU 85%, memory 90%, storage available 5 GiB.
monitor_limits_saved: Warning limits saved on this computer.
monitor_limits_session: Limits applied for this session. This computer could not save the preferences.
monitor_statistics_help: Minimum, average and peak use available samples in the selected history. Missing values are excluded, not counted as zero. Request response times are already one-minute averages; this table averages those readings.
monitor_export_saved: Resource readings saved. The CSV contains aggregate metrics only.
monitor_export_failed: The readings could not be saved. Try again.
monitor_session_history: Up to one hour of readings from this signed-in session. History clears on sign-out, reload or closing the Hub. Request metrics describe rolling one-minute windows; they cannot be added together as request totals.
monitor_request_scope: Connected apps are live classroom connections. Requests include background updates, but exclude browser permission checks. Response times end when the Hub starts sending its reply. Failed requests received an error reply.
monitor_document_scope: Finished and failed counts are since the Hub opened. Documents with no readable text count as failed.
monitor_transfers_scope: Transfers stay active until they finish or disconnect.
monitor_disk_activity_scope: Activity on the drive holding Hub data, including other programs.
monitor_storage_scope: Stored file sizes. Updates every 30 seconds. Database includes its working files.
monitor_adapter_help: Includes all programs using this connection.
monitor_no_adapter: Selected connection unavailable. Connect to the classroom network or choose another connection.
monitor_collecting: Collecting samples. The graph builds as readings arrive.
monitor_scope: Last 10 minutes. History clears on sign-out or closing the Hub.
monitor_computer_help: This computer includes L.A.R.A and other programs.
